submitMethod: GoHighLevel native form-builder (embedded, not an iframe). There is NO <form> element in the server-rendered HTML - GHL's Vue app wires the inputs and POSTs them to the GHL forms service at FORMS_SERVICE_URL = https://backend.leadconnectorhq.com. The form element on the page is <div id="_builder-form" name="builder-form"> inside <section id="form-builder">, wrapped by the funnel element <div id="form-5gd7-YxgNV" class="c-form c-wrapper form-5gd7-YxgNV">, which carries is-preview="true". On success the configured action is formAction.actionType = "1" (redirect) to https://jvaldeztreeservices.com/thank-you-page-89169333-5732.

inlineIcon.kind: inline and NOT a CSS background - it is the ONLY inline
inlineIcon.openingTag: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewbox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" class="input-icon" style="color:#1C1C1CFF;">
inlineIcon.wrapper: <div class="flex email-input relative"> - the icon is the first child, the <input> is the second.
inlineIcon.whyItMatters: This is why the email input carries style="padding-left:36px !important;" - the 36px left padding reserves space for the glyph. Rebuild both together or the placeholder will sit under the icon.
inlineIcon.colour: stroke="currentColor" with an inline style color:#1C1C1CFF on the <svg>, so the glyph paints #1C1C1C.
inlineIcon.noSizeAttributes: The <svg> has no width/height attributes; only viewbox="0 0 24 24". Size comes from the .input-icon class. No dimension is asserted here.
